description: Diagnostic-only module to diagnose why self_diagnostics is stale (17m age, threshold 600s). Reads PID file location for self_diagnostics, checks if process is alive via signal 0, inspects last heartbeat timestamp from service_health table, probes write_service connectivity. Outputs findings to log. Does NOT restart anything — this is diagnostic only, human operator uses output to decide restart action. Protected files (write_service, rug_pull_monitor) are excluded from probe even if also stale.
